definitions.explanation: The blank space on a form, contract, or delivery slip where the person signs their name. Also used of the signature box in an email or on a web form.

examples.japanese: {署名欄|しょめいらん}に{名前|なまえ}を{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write your name in the signature field.

examples.japanese: {署名欄|しょめいらん}が{空|あ}いたままだったので、{書類|しょるい}が{返|かえ}された。
examples.english: The signature field was left blank, so the document was sent back.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}の{最後|さいご}のページにある{署名欄|しょめいらん}に、{日付|ひづけ}と{住所|じゅうしょ}も{一緒|いっしょ}に{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: In the signature field on the last page of the contract, please also fill in the date and your address.

notes:
{署名|しょめい} (signature) + {欄|らん} (column, field on a form). The suffix {欄|らん} names any labeled blank on a document: {住所|じゅうしょ}{欄|らん} (address field), {備考|びこう}{欄|らん} (remarks field).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}に{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill in the signature field
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}にサインする: to sign in the signature field
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}が{空欄|くうらん}: the signature field is blank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {捺印欄|なついんらん}: seal field — the space for a personal seal, which many Japanese documents require instead of or alongside a signature
- {記入欄|きにゅうらん}: entry field — any blank to be filled in, not specifically for a name
